change_summary: Retain a canonical color-Clear-owned full-resolution native Draw/DrawIndexed batch across a verified same-device, offscreen TARGET-only menu or vehicle-preview Clear, rather than always aborting native output. Reject depth/stencil, uncertain RT0 and real backbuffer Clears while preserving D3D9 Draw/Present/gamepad fallback.

feature_contract.goal: Preserve the live full-frame menu-to-vehicle-to-race native Draw and DrawIndexed color chain across harmless auxiliary TARGET-only Clears while excluding uncertain main-buffer and depth Clears, without altering D3D9 gamepad and Present.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Same game device offscreen TARGET-only Clear preserves verified backbuffer color seed and following native Draw or DrawIndexed continuity.
Main RT0, depth/stencil, invalid surface identity and stopped native batches preserve original D3D9 Clear, Draw and gamepad, without unproven native frame output.
Five mandatory GitHub checks must succeed at the same source-bearing result SHA; Quest3/VDXR parity is independently untested.

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Explicit OUTRUN_DX11_FIRST_GAME_FRAME and OUTRUN_DX11_FULL_GAME_FRAME opt-in only; original D3D9 Clear/Draw/Present/gamepad preserved, no backend promotion.
